sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We have not yet received a response to our previous message, but as a long-standing partner to Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, we remain fully committed to our shared path. 

Our offer of €136.80 per unit remains on the table, incorporating the 14-day payment terms and the 1 January 2027 effective date. To be precise regarding our current Angebot, it is a price of €136.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Please let us know your position so we can conclude this negotiation. We take great pride in our craft and our enduring business relationships, and we look forward to finalizing this agreement together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to reach out to our long-standing partners at Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. As a family-run foundry deeply rooted in our region, we truly value the trust and close cooperation we have built between our companies over the years. 

We are following up as we have not yet received a reply to our previous proposal. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Our offer of €136.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027 remains open. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. 

Please let us know your position so we can conclude this adjustment. We look forward to your response and to continuing our reliable partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You have repeatedly recalled holding prices steady for us—it sounds like you want partnership to mean support in both directions. We value that support and want an adjustment grounded in verified costs that also recognises your cash-flow needs. If we accelerate payment, how could you reflect that benefit in the price adjustment while allowing a workable transition?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 30%, PPI-C241 24%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C241 +6.2%), your cost increase comes to about +2.0% of the price, not +9.5%. Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 86% of your invoices late, on average 3 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 3 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 127.31 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €136.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We appreciate your commitment to 14-day payment terms and the binding volume, which allows us to adjust our offer.
Your calculation relies on six-month index moves, whereas our costs have compounded over the full twelve months; please provide the data source for your six-month figures.
We can accept the later effective date of 1 January 2027 and 14-day payment terms, provided we agree on a price of €136.80 per unit.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
